notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, design or history for this tower was found in any source read. The record rests on the tnlandforms list (location, elevation, state number, standing) and the 2014 National Register form's extant list. The tnlandforms per-tower pages (m.php?wpt=MAT001) returned unrelated gambling spam rather than tower details, so the site may have been compromised; a human should check it. A MapQuest listing for a 'Macon County Fire Tower' at 771 Chaffin Rd, Lafayette returned no text and is not used; it may or may not be this tower. The 2014 list is the latest status evidence, so current standing is unverified. Access is unknown.
